model: Seal text = credential (shield/opener + holdings/goods/counts + office word); no personal-name stock; animal independent (S347, STATUS.md)

predictions.P1: Held-out (post-1977, non-IM77) texts: share of 3-5-sign texts nested whole inside longer texts > 2x the within-text-shuffled null
predictions.P2: Held-out texts reuse >=3-sign runs known from Mohenjo-daro/Harappa more than the shuffled null
predictions.P3: Future new seals (Rakhigarhi, Binjor, CISI 3.4): no middle recurs as a name more than the bigram null predicts (uniqueness ratio >= 0.9)
predictions.P4: Future sealings found abroad carry home formulas (opener + of + N + item, or known title endings) rather than unique names

kill: P1 and P2 fail on held-out sites; or new seals show a small stock of recurring name strings (ratio < 0.7)
